messages:
acme-cs: Hey team — since 09:12 UTC our customer is seeing p99s spike to ~11s on their Dedicated pool (region: eu-west). They reported a cascade of 502s + long tails. This started after a billing window burst.
emma (support): Thanks, filing and escalating. Can you drop the request ID and a sample timeframe? we'll ping oncall.
acme-cs: sample req: req_id=aa7f3b9c status=502 latency=11.3s route=dedicated-us-eu pool=acme-reserved time=2026-03-17T09:13:02Z
priya (oncall): looking. Seeing attach latencies & attach timeouts around that time. p95 ~ 850ms, p99 ~ 10-12s on that pool. Metrics: attach_queue_depth jumped x6 and attach_success_rate dipped to 87%.
shaun (sre): Any auth failures? sometimes auth retry storms push provisioning fallthroughs.
acme-cs: yes — around 09:12 we saw a handful of 401s then 500s. Logs: "auth: token verify failed, upstream 401" then attach attempt -> "attach_error: no backends ready".
leo (eng-platform): provisioning traces show a spike of concurrent attach requests for that pool at 09:11:40. The provisioner hit soft limit for new GPU allocations and started queuing. Cold-gpu init median ~4.8s, but tail ~9s.
priya (oncall): repro checks: curl to the customer's route returns either a streaming chunk after 10s or immediate 502 depending on which attach path wins. Example repro command:

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <cust-token>" -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?model=gpt-xx

response headers occasionally include: x-attach-time: 9543ms x-provisioner-queue: 47
emma (support): Is this isolated to that customer or hitting other Dedicated pools too?
shaun (sre): Early signal: a few other reserved pools show elevated attach queues but only this pool reached 10s tail. Looks correlated with a billing-window burst (priority customer spike) + transient auth failures which caused retries.
leo (eng-platform): Found related deploy-bot event at 09:09:57: deploy-bot: "rolling update: provisioner config bump (max-concurrent-allocs=18 -> 14)". That reduction would reduce allocation throughput during spikes.
priya (oncall): oof — who triggered that change? @leo can you check audit? we might be throttling ourselves during high demand.
leo (eng-platform): I see the config change was auto-rolled by a safety job (safety-guard) after a failed integration test earlier in the window. It reduced max concurrency temporarily. Reverting now.
deploy-bot: config-rollout complete: provisioner.max_concurrent_allocs set to 18 (rolled back), rollout_id=rb-20260317-09:20
shaun (sre): That explains slower allocation. Combine that with cold-gpu tail and auth fail/retry amplification -> attach queue piles up -> requests hit fallback/502 or long tails. Suggested mitigations:
- Immediate: bump pool min_ready_hosts for acme-reserved from 2 -> 6 (rapid prewarm)
- Immediate: enable temporary routing to hosted fallback for this customer (route policy: prefer-hosted-if-attach>5s)
- Short term: increase provisioner.max_concurrent_allocs back to 18 (done)
- Medium: enable proactive prewarm for billing-window high priority accounts and add jittered warmup schedule
priya (oncall): I'm running the bump to min_ready_hosts now. Also toggling feature-flag:dedicated:hosted-fallback for acme-cust.
emma (support): I'll tell the customer we have mitigations live (min hosts + fallback) and we reverted the rollback. ETA for noticeable p99 improvement?
shaun (sre): Expect p99 to drop within one cold-gpu cycle (~1-2 mins) after prewarm kicks in. Hard tails from cold init should be resolved as prewarmed hosts come online.
acme-cs: thanks — seeing immediate improvement in some requests, p99 dropped to ~3.2s at 09:22.
leo (eng-platform): Follow-ups:
- Add a guard to not auto-reduce max_concurrent_allocs during active high-traffic windows for reserved pools
- Add instrumented metric for auth_retry_amplification (retries/sec * attach_queue_depth)
- Audit token service errors around 09:11 to address root auth issue
priya (oncall): filing follow-up tickets and marking this P1 support escalation. Will attach timeline and config diff. Ticket: SUP-2026-1183.
emma (support): Notifying customer and leaving this thread open for final RCA.
acme-cs: appreciate the quick turn — please share RCA when ready.
shaun (sre): quick logs snippet for archive:

[09:11:40] provisioner: queue_depth=62 in_flight_allocs=12 max_allowed=14 reason=soft-limit
[09:12:03] gpu-init: start host=host-az3 init_ms=4820
[09:12:04] auth-svc: verify_token err=upstream-401 count=7
[09:12:12] attach: success req=aa7f3b9c attach_time=11234ms

(archiving to incident tracker)
leo (eng-platform): I'll draft the config guard RFC and propose a prewarm policy change — linking to SUP-2026-1183.
priya (oncall): closing loop once RCA doc is in. For now: mitigations succeeded and customer reported partial recovery at 09:22. Marking degraded->recovering.
emma (support): thanks everyone. :tada:"
